description: Every option here is written down and set to the value that disables it. The verdicts match the permissive fixture and the explanation does not: somebody decided this rather than never having considered it, and a report telling them to set an option they already set to the other value reads as though nobody looked. It is also the case that proves an explicitly empty userns-remap is treated as disabled, which is what dockerd does with it, and the one fixture where experimental is explicitly false rather than merely unwritten - CONTAINERS-0005 passes over both and has to say which it saw.
